summary: Object factory/constructor. Allocates 76 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; on success constructs the object by calling sub_490B00 on the new memory with argument a2 and stores the result into this+0x0; on allocation failure stores 0. Returns this. Structural twin of ObjectAllocator (0045bb90).

operations.description: Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(76) to allocate 76 bytes; result kept as v3.
Branch on allocation result v3: non-zero means allocation succeeded.
On success call sub_490B00(v3, a2) to construct/initialize the object at the allocated memory.
Store the sub_490B00 result into this+0x0 (success path).
On allocation failure store 0 into this+0x0.
